import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Generate synthetic monthly adjusted close prices from 2010 to 2023
np.random.seed(42)  # For reproducibility
date_range = pd.date_range(start='2010-01-01', end='2023-12-01', freq='M')
n = len(date_range)

# Create a synthetic price series with a trend and some noise
trend = np.linspace(100, 200, n)  # Linear trend from 100 to 200
seasonal_effect = 10 * np.sin(np.linspace(0, 3 * np.pi, n))  # Seasonal effect
noise = np.random.normal(0, 5, n)  # Random noise
prices = trend + seasonal_effect + noise

# Create a DataFrame
synthetic_data = pd.DataFrame({'Date': date_range, 'Adjusted_Close': prices})
synthetic_data.set_index('Date', inplace=True)

# Display the first few rows of the synthetic dataset
synthetic_data.head()

from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller

# Perform the Augmented Dickey-Fuller test
adf_result = adfuller(synthetic_data['Adjusted_Close'])

# Extract the test statistic and p-value
adf_statistic = adf_result[0]
p_value = adf_result[1]

adf_statistic, p_value

# Apply first differencing to the synthetic dataset
synthetic_data['Differenced'] = synthetic_data['Adjusted_Close'].diff().dropna()

# Perform the Augmented Dickey-Fuller test on the differenced data
adf_result_diff = adfuller(synthetic_data['Differenced'].dropna())

# Extract the test statistic and p-value
adf_statistic_diff = adf_result_diff[0]
p_value_diff = adf_result_diff[1]

adf_statistic_diff, p_value_diff

from arch import arch_model

# Fit a GARCH(1, 1) model to the differenced data
garch_model = arch_model(synthetic_data['Differenced'].dropna(), vol='Garch', p=1, q=1)
garch_fit = garch_model.fit(disp="off")

# Forecast the next 12 months
forecast = garch_fit.forecast(horizon=12)
forecasted_values = forecast.mean.iloc[-1].values

# Display the forecasted values
forecasted_values

from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA

# Fit an ARIMA model to the differenced data
# We'll use (p=1, d=1, q=1) as a starting point
arima_model = ARIMA(synthetic_data['Adjusted_Close'], order=(1, 1, 1))
arima_fit = arima_model.fit()

# Forecast the next 12 months
arima_forecast = arima_fit.forecast(steps=12)

# Display the forecasted values
arima_forecast

# Generate a synthetic test set with known values around the forecasted values
# Adding some noise to the forecasted values to simulate real-world data
test_set_dates = pd.date_range(start='2023-12-31', periods=12, freq='M')
test_set_values = arima_forecast + np.random.normal(0, 1, 12)  # Adding some noise

# Create a DataFrame for the test set
test_set = pd.DataFrame({'Date': test_set_dates, 'Adjusted_Close': test_set_values})
test_set.set_index('Date', inplace=True)

# Calculate RMSE
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((arima_forecast.values - test_set['Adjusted_Close'].values) ** 2))
rmse, test_set
